constant_baselines.note: the agreement rate must be read against the 0.709 always-advancing baseline: the derived L1 label is 105/110 advancing

caveat: IndEgo keysteps are demo-style assembly/logistics tasks recorded for a research dataset; the 4 annotated clips are one worker's one task each, so nothing here transfers to factory work without testing it there. L2 has no variance on this subset and 4 groups make the grouped CI weak. These are descriptive rates on dataset-shipped annotations, not accuracy of a product on unlabelled video.

config.l1_rule: advancing iff annotated step intervals cover >50% of the 10-s window, else no_relevant_work
config.l2_rule: completed iff the annotation reaches the last step of the clip's matched task list
